# Rules Core

Global engineering guidance for evidence-based, scoped, pragmatic coding work. The
[skill bulletin](core.md) keeps the four core rules concise. Maintain longer explanations
and examples centrally in the [detailed reference](ai-principles.md); read it only
when clarification is needed. Global installation makes the skill available across projects; its instructions load when
invoked or selected, not automatically in every session. For always-on rules, use the host's
global or project instructions explicitly, without duplicating conflicting rule documents.
